name: Glass Chess Required Update
notes: Adds Quick Match matchmaking with automatic opponent pairing and cancellation
Adds shareable private friend invitations with cryptographically random eight-character codes
Validates every online move against the server position and requires an expected move number
Adds server-issued reconnect credentials and a 30-second disconnect recovery window
Adds a JSON health endpoint for the online server and bounds HTTP fallback responses
Adds automated Socket.IO integration coverage for matchmaking, challenges, moves, and reconnects
